messages:
deploy-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: CI pipeline pushed an image tagged 'latest' into prod-canary registry at 3178887777. Health checks failing on canary pods. Paging on-call.
liz: seeing pod restarts on canary svc. errors: OOMKilled + image pull OK but containers crash quickly. no 5xx spikes yet in frontend.
sam: copying logs, looks like startup error: incompatible binary version. suspect wrong build tag. can you paste the image ref from the canary deployment?
maria: canary deployment image: registry.redwood.example.com/runtime:latest (digest sha256:deadbeef)
jon: expected tag for this rollout was runtime:2026-03-07-rc2. 'latest' shouldn't be used for prod. where did that tag come from? @sam any CI webhook anomalies?
sam: checking CI run 54321 — pipeline published two tags, due to parallel worker race it pushed latest after the stable tag. artifact storage shows two manifests with same digest but one untested push overwrote manifest create timestamp.
ana: (support) customer-facing: no reports yet but we have a few internal telemetry traces for failed generation requests routed to that canary latency bucket.
liz: immediate mitigation: pause rollout, scale down canary to 0 replicas. I'll run kubectl for canary pause and remove label selector to avoid traffic.
maria: also initiating feature-flag kill-switch for new-inference-route to force traffic off canary. can someone confirm flag toggled?
jon: I flipped ff:new_inference_route -> off via LaunchDarkly, confirmed. traffic back to stable.
sam: rolling canary down:

```
kubectl scale deploy/llm-runtime-canary -n prod --replicas=0
kubectl annotate deploy/llm-runtime-canary redwood/control=paused
```
liz: pods terminated, no new canary pods starting. ingress still routing stable. monitoring shows 0 canary requests.
ana: I'll prepare a short customer impact note: "Reduced capacity on new-inference route for a small fraction of users between 17:09-17:18 UTC, no data loss, rollback to stable."
maria: next steps: incident backlog item to fix our CI tag race (force manifest pin by build id), add guard to reject 'latest' pushes in prod registry, and postmortem assignment to eng-infra.
jon: oncall handoff in 30m. I'll stay until handoff complete and then update the incident channel. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
sam: reproducer note: parallel jobs writing to same tag — add unique tag + GC policy. I'll open PR to change publish step to push immutable tags and only update a 'release' pointer after successful checks.
liz: created short runbook entry in /ops/runbooks/canary_bad_tag for quick mitigation steps.
deploy-bot: ACTION LOGGED: incident created #INC-2026-31788877, assigned eng-infra. Timestamps logged."
